description: Props, movers, triggers and the rescue (WP 4.1): the hero rides a platform east and back; a swing at step 60 topples two stacks of crates into the pit zone; at step 90, mid-ride with the crates in the air, the physics world is captured and restored in place from its text form (the goldens are those of the run without it); at step 300 the barrel is dropped through the floor and the rescue puts it back on its tile.
